description: This PHP source file defines the `UserRole` entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the `ohrm_user_role` database table. It includes properties for role identification, display names, and flags for assignability and predefined status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Entity class representing user roles in the HRM system, with properties for role attributes and methods to access and modify them.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user role.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the user role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the role.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the role.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of the role.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the role.

methods.name: isAssignable
methods.description: Checks if the role is assignable.

methods.name: setIsAssignable
methods.description: Sets whether the role is assignable.

methods.name: isPredefined
methods.description: Checks if the role is predefined.

methods.name: setIsPredefined
methods.description: Sets whether the role is predefined.
